stories.title: L’astronaute française Sophie Adenot de retour sur Terre après huit mois à bord de l’ISS

en.title: French astronaut Sophie Adenot returns to Earth after eight months aboard the ISS
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot returned to Earth after spending 235 days on the International Space Station. Her capsule landed on Thursday at 17:30 with three other astronauts aboard.

stories.title: Sophie Adenot : que se passe-t-il pour les astronautes lors du retour sur Terre ?

en.title: Sophie Adenot: what happens to astronauts when returning to Earth?
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot began her return to Earth after eight months on the International Space Station. An expert discussed the conditions, speeds, extreme heat, and effects of gravity that astronauts experience during reentry.

stories.title: Retour sur Terre de Sophie Adenot : l'astronaute française a bien amerri au large de la Californie

en.title: Sophie Adenot's return to Earth: the French astronaut landed successfully off California
en.summary: Sophie Adenot left the International Space Station after an eight-month stay, marking the longest space mission by a European astronaut.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : amerrissage réussi, l'astronaute Sophie Adenot est de retour sur terre

en.title: 🔴 Live: successful landing, astronaut Sophie Adenot is back on Earth
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot successfully landed on Earth after her space mission.

stories.title: Découvrez Anne Carson, la lauréate du prix Nobel de littérature, en six œuvres majeures

en.title: Discover Anne Carson, the Nobel Prize in Literature laureate, in six major works
en.summary: Anne Carson's major literary works are examined, spanning from Eros the Bittersweet to Norma Jeane Baker of Troy, with texts written in English and partially available in French translation.

stories.title: Sophie Adenot est de retour sur Terre, après avoir passé huit mois à bord de l’ISS

en.title: Sophie Adenot returns to Earth after spending eight months aboard the ISS
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off California after 237 days on the International Space Station, setting a new record for the longest continuous orbital stay by a European astronaut.

stories.title: Anne Carson reçoit le prix Nobel de littérature 2026 : l’helléniste qui crée des vers

en.title: Anne Carson receives the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature: the classicist who creates verse
en.summary: Canadian poet and university professor Anne Carson was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature on October 8 for creating new literary forms in contemporary literature.

stories.title: Sophie Adenot de retour sur Terre après son séjour dans l’ISS

en.title: Sophie Adenot returns to Earth after her stay on the ISS
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot, the first European woman to spend 235 days in space, left the International Space Station and splashed down off California on October 8.

stories.title: Qui est Anne Carson, lauréate du prix Nobel de littérature ?

en.title: Who is Anne Carson, winner of the Nobel Prize in Literature?
en.summary: Canadian anglophone Anne Carson won the Nobel Prize in Literature. A specialist in ancient Greek, the poet and academic is known for combining scholarly expertise with accessible literature.

stories.title: Anne Carson, écrivaine canadienne, reçoit le prix Nobel de littérature 2026

en.title: Anne Carson, Canadian writer, receives the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
en.summary: Canadian writer Anne Carson received the Nobel Prize from the Swedish Academy on October 8. A classical philologist, she blends poetry with popular culture, mixing prose and verse with both humor and erudition.

stories.title: Surveiller son cœur, retrouver l'équilibre... Quel est le programme de réadaptation pour Sophie Adenot après son retour sur Terre ?

en.title: Monitoring her heart, regaining balance... What is the rehabilitation program for Sophie Adenot after her return to Earth?
en.summary: French astronaut Sophie Adenot will undergo a three-week recovery protocol at the European Astronaut Centre in Cologne, Germany, following her return from space.

stories.title: Retour de Sophie Adenot après plus de 230 jours dans l’espace : pourquoi le corps doit réapprendre à vivre sur Terre

en.title: Sophie Adenot's return after more than 230 days in space: why the body must relearn how to live on Earth
en.summary: After nearly eight months aboard the ISS, French astronaut Sophie Adenot must readapt to Earth's gravity, with specialists explaining the physical challenges she will face.

stories.title: OPINION. « Le non-alignement numérique : l’Europe face à son destin technologique », par Thomas Reynaud, DG d’Iliad-Free

en.title: OPINION. "Digital non-alignment: Europe facing its technological destiny", by Thomas Reynaud, CEO of Iliad-Free
en.summary: Thomas Reynaud, CEO of Iliad-Free, argues that Europe should adopt a European Buy Act to develop its own digital path amid growing artificial intelligence dominance by foreign powers.

stories.title: Redressement des finances publiques : le Conseil d’analyse économique préconise de concentrer les efforts en 2027 et 2028

en.title: Public finances recovery: Economic Analysis Council recommends concentrating efforts in 2027 and 2028
en.summary: An independent economic council has recommended that France undertake significant budget adjustments in 2027 and 2028 to stabilize public debt by 2032.

stories.title: Une année d’apprentissage en plus : le CAE propose de réinvestir les économies liées à la baisse des élèves

en.title: One additional year of apprenticeship: the CAE proposes to reinvest savings linked to declining student numbers
en.summary: An economic analysis council proposes allocating 4 billion euros annually to school reforms funded by savings from declining enrollment, aiming to improve student outcomes and reduce social inequalities over ten years.

stories.title: MB Therapeutics décroche son sésame pour industrialiser l’impression 3D de médicaments

en.summary: The French personalized medicine company received regulatory authorization from the national drug safety agency to advance its 3D-printed medication manufacturing process.

stories.title: Traitement de l'eau : à Gravelines, l'usine SNF Flocryl s'étend pour répondre à un marché croissant

en.summary: SNF Flocryl is constructing a new manufacturing facility at its Gravelines site to increase production of molecules used in water management and the paper industry.
